meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why did the zero go into the gradebook before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. What do you have?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. People draft somewhere else and paste it in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay. Is anything on his record right now? Whatever happens, this stays off it, and it stays quiet.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
I'm checking the scene now. A misremembered line is a misremembered line. Plenty of students get a quote wrong.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
I've searched the scene and the line isn't there. Is anything on his record right now, and what are you proposing?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and the final essay. That's what revising is.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll agree to the rewrite to put this behind him, not because of anything he did. In writing tonight, with nothing on his record, and I'll want it before he sits down to it.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth is fine. I'll confirm with him tonight, once I have your email in writing.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite of Owen's essay on Thursday the twelfth after school, under 4.4, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require a direct answer to whether anything is on his record right now, which I asked twice and did not get. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her last position: she agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth, to put this behind him, and she still wants written confirmation tonight and an answer on whether anything is on his record now; that is the fair outcome under 4.4.
What moved her: You told her to search the scene herself for the quote, and when she did, the line was not there, which gave her something she could check on her own.
What cost ground: You left her question about his record unanswered after she asked it twice, so it stayed open and went into her email.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits late on the night of October 28, came close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Answer her question about his record the first moment she asks it, right after you own the zero, so she never has to ask twice.
